title: [Feature][Model][v0.32] Enable Qwen3.8 Flash Next PP and SP
body:
## Summary

Port the Qwen3.8 Flash Next pipeline-parallel (PP) and sequence-parallel (SP/FlashComm1) support from #20311 to the `releases/v0.32.0rc` release branch. The packed QSA/GDN/PLE KV-cache layout remains safe for PP stage-local ownership.

## Changes

This PR preserves the complete twelve-commit PP+SP series from #20311, including:

- FlashComm1/SP enablement for Qwen3.8 Flash Next.
- PP-compatible model-state and intermediate-tensor handling.
- QSA main-attention fused RMSNorm + MRoPE projection on the target model, while retaining the graph-safe upstream decomposition for the MTP draft model.
- MRV2 PP/SP token padding and full-token feedback handling.
- PP-aware packed QSA/GDN/PLE cache planning.
- Runner-level SP padding scoped to `PP > 1`, avoiding duplicate model-internal SP padding in SP-only deployments.
- Compatibility patch documentation and source-regression coverage.

The release branch is descended from the original #20311 base. All twelve commits therefore cherry-pick cleanly onto `releases/v0.32.0rc` without conflict, while preserving author and committer attribution.

## Motivation

Qwen3.8 Flash Next already supports packed QSA/GDN/PLE cache storage and MRV2 on Ascend. PP partitions model layers across stages, while SP/FlashComm1 shards tokens across tensor-parallel ranks. The original single-stage assumptions caused PP startup failures when state owners were aggregated across stages or PLE existed on only one stage. This work enables PP+SP together without weakening the packed-cache ownership model.

## Validation

- `pytest -q tests/ut/models/test_qwen4_exp_cache_config.py tests/ut/models/test_qwen4_exp_source_regression.py tests/ut/models/qwen4_exp/test_qsa_upstream_abi.py`: **33 passed** on the rebased `releases/v0.32.0rc` branch.
- Changed Python files pass `py_compile`.
- `git diff --check` passes.
- Original #20311 16-card A3 service validation: TP=8, PP=2, DP=1, FlashComm1/SP enabled, MRV2 with 3 speculative tokens; service reached HTTP health 200, completed PP cache planning and graph capture, and returned a semantically correct `/v1/chat/completions` response.

Additional original #20311 service validation:

- SP only: `TP=8, PP=1, DP=2`, FlashComm1 enabled; single curl and all 8/8 requests passed for 8K→3, 16K→1K, and 131K→1K.
- PP+SP: `TP=4, PP=2, DP=2`, FlashComm1 enabled; service reached HTTP health 200 and returned a semantically correct `/v1/chat/completions` response.

### GPQA Diamond final result (TP4 / PP2 / DP1, rear 8 NPUs)

- Total: 198
- Correct: 181
- Incorrect: 17
- Parse failures: 0
- Request failures: 0
- Accuracy: **91.41%** (181/198)

These performance and accuracy results are migrated from #20311; the release-branch port preserves the same implementation series.

## Relationship to prior work

- Original main-target PR: #20311
- This PR targets `releases/v0.32.0rc` and preserves the original twelve commits and authorship.
